Title: This Sakura Kinako KitKat Only Exists at Don Quijote

Description:
I found this Sakura Kinako KitKat at Don Quijote in Osaka — cherry blossom and roasted soybean powder (kinako) mixed into a white chocolate KitKat. Nestlé's own official account confirmed this flavor is exclusive to Don Quijote. Flip the box over and it checks out: sakura leaf powder dusted on the chocolate, real kinako mixed into the wafer cream. Reviews are split — some say the kinako smell hits the second you open the bag, others say the kinako taste is fainter than expected. This flavor first showed up around 2018 and still keeps coming back to Don Quijote shelves as a seasonal item years later.
